description: Upload a signed .aab. IMPORTANT: uploading does NOT attach the artifact to the release — it only becomes an app-level artifact (visible with its own version code) while the release's addedArtifacts stays empty, so start_rollout would have nothing to roll out. Call attach_artifact_to_release next, then get_release to check signing/content validation, then start_rollout. This call only confirms the bytes arrived and that Play accepted the bundle for processing.

bundle_base64.description: The .aab inline as base64. Exists for symmetry with the image tools but is capped at 64 KiB, far below any real bundle — use bundle_url.

bundle_path.description: Absolute path ON THE REPLAY HOST, inside the secops container (repo root = /app). Only usable if you can already put files there — most operators cannot, so prefer bundle_url.

bundle_url.description: https URL the replay host downloads the signed .aab from — the route for a bundle built on your own machine, since bundle_path only sees files already on the replay host. Must be publicly resolvable.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

release_id.description: Release id on this track, from create_release/get_track.

track_id.description: Numeric track id (e.g. the long digits in the Play Console URL's .../tracks/<this>/..., not the human alias like "internal"). Call list_tracks first to find it.

name: upload_bundle
